note: Labelled practice defaults for HEURISTIC business modules. Invented from general business sense to give the right direction; no literature source, no calibration on any game. Not a forecast. A parameter pack may override any key under modules.<key>.

marketing.media_mix.why: Relative reach weight per medium; equal-ish weights make a spread budget more effective than one medium.

sales_force.why: Scale chosen for the synthetic pack's price level: a handful of salespeople per open market moves demand noticeably, a large force saturates.
